name: kilo-mcp
description: MCP server + Kilo-specific skills for delegating implementation work from an orchestrating AI to Kilo Code - the Kilo binding of the Architect/Executor pattern

plugins.name: architect-side
plugins.description: Kilo-specific Architect-side skills: mcp-orchestrator, mcp-metrics-analyst, kilo-mcp-conflict-resolver, plus the mcp-orchestrator-agent subagent. Install this if you're the orchestrating AI delegating to Kilo via MCP. The MCP server itself (server.py) is registered separately - see README.md.

plugins.name: executor-side
plugins.description: Kilo-specific Executor-side skills: kilo-mcp-headless-executor, kilo-mcp-rag-explorer. Install this on the Kilo side, not the orchestrating AI's side.
